data.narrative:
DNA Script is a Series C-stage biotech company that has raised $200M+ to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comparables universe of 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in Biotech & Health, with particular focus on 3 same-stage private companies: Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and New Limit ($3.1B).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement to the $200M raised proxy, implying a $340M valuation. Peer-median anchoring across the 3 same-sector, same-stage private peers yields a $3.8B median (range: $3.1B–$10.3B). Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (median 6.2x across the 3 tickers) cannot be applied due to absence of target revenue disclosure, common for private companies.

The two applicable methods produce a wide implied range. Stage-progression suggests $340M; peer-median suggests $3.8B. Triangulation across methods supports a valuation corridor of $289M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.1B. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion within the peer set—Colossal's $10.3B valuation materially exceeds Chai and New Limit—and the unknown revenue profile that would enable public-comp validation. Stage maturity and commercial trajectory within the sector remain the primary drivers of fair value within this range.
